title: Tencent's Hong Kong-listed shares fall ~7%, the most since April 2025, as investors worry over "rumors" of weaker earnings on August 12, and NetEase drops 5%+ (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Tencent's Hong Kong-listed shares fall ~7%, the most since April 2025, as investors worry over “rumors” of weaker earnings on August 12, and NetEase drops 5%+ — Tencent Holdings Ltd. fell the most in over a year, dragging Chinese gaming stocks lower as investors grew concerned …
